candidates.titulo: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
candidates.resumen: Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can give more helpful answers to complex questions, including "questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests." The new model can break down your questions and address each part in its responses. candidates.titulo: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
candidates.resumen: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

candidates.titulo: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds
candidates.resumen:
Shoppers using AI chatbots to research products or find places to buy items could be directed to imposters and other risky websites, a new study found.

candidates.titulo: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
candidates.resumen:

candidates.titulo: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks
candidates.resumen: The airline said it will not allow customers to use AI agents to book flights and manage reservations.
